text:
If your Tuesday plans can handle a gray start, Burlington stays cool and mostly cloudy, with rain showers most likely this morning into early afternoon before easing for most of the evening. The call is a high near 74, but the models are split on how wet we get, so I’d keep the rain jacket handy rather than count on a dry day. The lake should be manageable early, with east to southeast winds 10 knots or less and 1-to-2-foot waves, but the clouds and occasional showers won’t make it a postcard day. Water temperature is a comfortable 72.

Wednesday looks similar at first, with a high near 74 and showers becoming more likely after 4. Then the weather turns decidedly wetter overnight, with a 90% chance of showers and thunderstorms, some heavy rain possible. South winds will build to 15 to 25 knots, pushing waves up to 3 to 5 feet. Take the lake early, and finish outdoor plans before late afternoon Wednesday.
